front: I totally get why you'd worry about kids spending more time on screens. But actually, the platform frees up teachers for more face-to-face activities.
back: S2 — валидация concern перед pivot. Структура: I totally get why you'd think [X]. But actually, [Y]. Секция: problem->solution.
example: Daily: I get why you'd think it's too expensive. But actually, it pays for itself in two months.

front: What we tend to see is that students progress faster when the platform adapts to their pace.
back: S5 — смягчение утверждения. Структура: What we tend to see is that [Subject] [Verb] when [Condition]. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: What we tend to see is that people stick with it when they see quick results.

front: Instead of seeing AI as a replacement for your teachers, it's more useful to think of it as a teaching assistant that never gets tired.
back: S3 — рефрейминг негатива. Структура: Instead of seeing [X] as [negative], it's more useful to think of it as [positive]. Секция: problem->solution.
example: Daily: Instead of seeing the new schedule as a problem, think of it as a chance to reorganize.

front: That's a fair concern about the cost. Let me show you what happened when three centers in Hanoi adopted this last year.
back: S4 — ответ на concern с evidence. Структура: That's a fair concern. Let me show you what happened when [someone] tried this. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: That's a fair concern. Let me show you what happened when my colleague tried the same approach.

front: The main objection assumes you need technical staff to run this, but that doesn't account for the automated setup — it runs itself.
back: S19 — отбивание возражения. Структура: The main objection assumes [X], but that doesn't account for [Y]. Секция: problem->solution.
example: Daily: The main objection assumes it takes months, but that doesn't account for the streamlined onboarding.

front: What really makes this work is the adaptive algorithm that pinpoints each student's weak spots.
back: S6 — it-cleft для акцента. Структура: What really makes this work is [NP]. Секция: solution.
example: Daily: What really makes this work is the simplicity — anyone can pick it up in a day.

front: What sets us apart from the usual approach is that students get instant feedback on every sentence they speak.
back: S7 — what-cleft для дифференциации. Структура: What sets us apart from the usual approach is [NP]. Секция: solution.
example: Daily: What sets this place apart from the others is the chef actually comes to your table.

front: Not only does it reduce your teachers' workload, but it also gives parents real-time updates on their child's progress.
back: S8 — dual benefit. Структура: Not only does it [X], but it also [Y]. Секция: solution/evidence.
example: Daily: Not only does it save time, but it also cuts costs by about thirty percent.

front: You rarely see a platform that actually keeps kids engaged for more than two weeks.
back: S9 — редкость результата. Структура: You rarely see a [NP] that actually [Verb]. Секция: solution.
example: Daily: You rarely see a manager who actually listens to feedback like that.

front: So it's really up to directors like you to adopt this before your competitors do.
back: S13 — ответственность. Структура: So it's really up to [person] like you to [action] before [consequence]. Секция: ask.
example: Daily: So it's up to you to set the tone before the team loses motivation.

front: The platform adjusts difficulty in real time, thereby keeping every student in their optimal learning zone.
back: S10 — прямое следствие. Структура: [Main clause], thereby [gerund] [object]. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: We automated the reports, thereby saving each teacher about three hours a week.

front: The main reason is simply that students practice more when the content feels relevant to their lives.
back: S11 — объяснение причины. Структура: The main reason is simply that [Clause]. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: The main reason is simply that people don't know the rules, not that they don't care.

front: (deprecated) This phenomenon stems primarily from the fact that [Clause].
back: Deprecated 2026-08-25: заменён на S11 (id 12). Старый код: G11.

front: By combining AI conversation practice with teacher-led activities, we directly address the shortage of qualified English teachers.
back: S12 — стратегическое выравнивание. Структура: By combining [X] with [Y], we directly address [problem]. Секция: solution.
example: Daily: By combining exercise with diet changes, you directly address the root cause, not just the symptoms.

front: The data clearly shows a strong link between Decision 2371 and the surge in demand for English teachers.
back: S15 — связь двух фактов. Структура: The data clearly shows a strong link between [A] and [B]. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: The data clearly shows a strong link between sleep quality and productivity at work.

front: When you put it all together, the numbers clearly show that centers using AI tools fill their classes faster than those that don't.
back: S16 — синтез вывода. Структура: When you put it all together, the numbers clearly show that [Clause]. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: When you put it all together, the numbers clearly show that remote work isn't going away.

front: Our first trial showed a clear improvement in speaking confidence — students went from avoiding English to volunteering in class.
back: S17 — результаты пилота. Структура: Our first trial showed a clear improvement in [area]. Секция: evidence.
example: Daily: Our first attempt showed a clear improvement in response time.

front: (deprecated) The central premise underpinning this methodology is that [Clause].
back: Deprecated 2026-08-25: заменён на S18 (id 19). Старый код: G17.

front: Now that we've covered the theory, let me show you how it actually works in a real classroom.
back: S18 — переход к практике. Структура: Now that we've covered the theory, let me show you how it actually works. Секция: solution.
example: Daily: Now that we've covered the basics, let me show you how it actually works in practice.

front: So to wrap up — bringing this in puts your center in a position to offer something no competitor in your district currently has.
back: S20 — закрытие и призыв. Структура: So to wrap up — bringing this in puts your center in a position to [Verb]. Секция: ask/close.
example: Daily: So to wrap up — making this change puts you in a position to attract better talent.

back: Базовое объяснение AI простыми словами

front: A prompt is a set of clear instructions you write to tell the AI exactly what to make or write for you.
back: Определение промпта

front: English is learned THROUGH commanding AI: the child uses English as a key to solve real tasks.
back: Английский учится ЧЕРЕЗ командование ИИ: ребёнок использует английский как ключ к решению реальных задач

back: Рыночный контекст: Decision 2371

back: Боль родителей: стресс детей (статистика)

back: Боль родителей: IELTS пузырь

back: Боль родителей: кейс закрывшихся центров

front: The white spot: nobody offers English THROUGH AI project work with a public English defense for 10-14 year olds.
back: Белое пятно - ядро оффера

front: The course runs through licensed partner centers; data is protected by the digital mask and dual consent under PDPL.
back: Легальность: PDPL и защита данных

back: Что мы продаём на самом деле

back: Методологический аргумент: two-sigma

front: A working website plus a public defense in English is demonstrated output: parents film it and share it.
back: Демонстрация результата

front: The course is built on the CLIL 4C framework: Content, Communication, Cognition and Culture are targeted in every single lesson.
back: Методология: CLIL 4C

front: The course covers all seven Gold Standard PBL elements: a challenging problem, sustained inquiry, authenticity, student voice and choice, reflection, critique and revision, and a public product.
back: Методология: PBL Gold Standard (7 элементов)

front: Every lesson follows the Gradual Release of Responsibility: I do, We do, You do together, You do - scaffolding is removed step by step.
back: Методология: GRR (gradual release)

front: The rubric weighs process over product: 40% Prompt Journal, 30% oral defense, 30% the site itself.
back: Рубрика оценивания 40/30/30
